Verified compatibility basis: ecobee website states support for 2-stage heat pumps, 2-stage conventional heating, 2-stage cooling, and variable-speed air handlers. Added one-line comparison to Nest Learning Thermostat (4th gen, B0D5BBYRJM) already on site. Added affiliate-disclosure near top. Updated frontmatter with 2 ecobee source URLs with retrieval dates.
